title: Stopwatch
h1: Stopwatch — Free Online Timer with Laps
seoTitle: Stopwatch — Free Online Timer with Lap Times
description: Simple browser stopwatch with start, stop, reset and lap times. Runs entirely in your browser with no uploads.
intro: Start, stop and reset a precise stopwatch. Record lap times and see elapsed time in hours, minutes, seconds and milliseconds. Everything stays on your device.
blurb: Free online stopwatch with lap times that runs entirely in your browser.
howItWorks: Press Start to begin timing. The display updates in real time.
Press Lap to record the current elapsed time without stopping.
Press Stop to pause, then Start to resume from the same point.
Press Reset to clear the timer and all laps.
examples: Time a presentation and record lap times for each section.
Measure how long a task takes and keep a history of attempts.

faq.q: Does the stopwatch keep running if I switch tabs?
faq.a: Yes for short periods, but browsers may throttle timers in background tabs. Keep the tab visible for highest accuracy.
No. The timer runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
